form_receipt_time: set by the organizer from the Google Form

problems.loads_sample_data: yes, seeded on start via fetch('/data/P12_personal_ledger_public.json') and case PUB-01

R1.evidence: First-run salary, inline salary editing, quick text entry, editable review, expense edit/delete, and salary-bound validation are implemented in src/App.jsx.

R2.evidence: Image upload, preview, editable shop/date/category/amount, and an explicitly blank uncertain amount work. The extraction is a deterministic mock (selectReceipt in src/App.jsx returns a fixed result); real OCR/vision is not implemented.

R3.evidence: Salary, spent, remaining, category chart, largest transactions, sortable/searchable spending, calendar, and same-period month comparison are derived from the ledger.

R4.evidence: Historical-remainder or daily-rate fallback forecasts expected remaining spend and signed month-end balance. Three category-and-amount observations are generated whenever spending exists.

R5.evidence: Goal name, item, target, editable repeated contribution, saved total, forecast-affordable amount, forecast completion, stated annual DPS rate, monthly interest rule, deposits, interest, and projected value are present.

known_limitations: receipt and natural-language understanding are mock rules, not AI OCR
ledger persists per-browser via localStorage, not synced
spending beyond income is clamped for display; the raw totals remain in the list
